AI tools for your daily business

Start here. These six tools cover most PMM workflows.

SAP Joule Available now

Front door for SAP-specific transactions and answers — product features, process guidance, and in-product tasks.

  • → SAP One + Joule
  • → ONE Joule Hub (SharePoint)
Microsoft Copilot Available now

The workhorse across M365. Right default for drafting, summarizing, and structuring everyday work.

  • → Copilot Chat (Direct)
  • → M365 Web Apps
GenAI Experience Lab Available now

Multi-model playground with data protection. Compare foundation models, prototype prompts, try the PowerPoint generator.

  • → Launch GenAI Lab
  • → Lab overview & onboarding (SharePoint)
Perplexity Pro Licensed

Research with citations. Rapid scanning of competitor content and market claims with sources attached.

  • → Perplexity
  • → Comet Browser
Claude Code Powerful

Agentic coding assistant that also produces interactive web artifacts, React prototypes, and HTML battlecards.

  • → Rollout announcement (SharePoint)
  • → Easy installation guide (GitHub Enterprise)
EKX New

The knowledge graph in chat form. Built for enumeration and fact-checking where generic LLMs would fabricate.

  • → EKX Chat
  • → EKX keynote video (SAP Video)

Three things to try this week

01

Ask EKX a fact question

"List all SAP products with machine learning capabilities" — get enumeration that generic LLMs would hallucinate.

Open tool →

02

Run a CompeteGPT query

Search for the competitor you're currently battlecarding. See win/loss patterns and positioning shifts.

Open tool →

03

Try Perplexity with citations

Research a market trend and keep the citations — useful for positioning docs and exec briefings.

Open tool →

Common use cases

First drafts

Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft blogs, emails, or outlines — then edit instead of starting blank.

Competitive intel

CompeteGPT for internal win/loss. Perplexity for external market research with sources.

Fact-checking

EKX for SAP-specific enumeration and accuracy without hallucination.

Document summaries

Drop analyst reports or long PDFs into Copilot or Claude for key points fast.

Brainstorming

Generate messaging variations, positioning angles, or campaign options — then apply judgment.

Interactive artifacts

Claude Code for HTML battlecards, calculators, and interactive demos.
